Name: Trafalgar Law - Fashion Sense
Author: Juchliate
Description:
Bring the Surgeon of Death to Pelican Town. This Fashion Sense outfit lets you play as Trafalgar Law in Stardew Valley, complete with his spotted hat, yellow shirt, blue cape, and katana.

FEATURES

• Four-direction walking animations with a moving cape, katana, and red cord.
• Four-direction item-carrying poses that display the item selected in your inventory.
• Custom seated poses for all four directions.
• Left-handed poses for the pickaxe, axe, and hoe, using Stardew Valley’s original tool sprites.
• Centered portraits in the Hand Mirror, Inventory, and Skills menus.
• A custom Law icon on the Skills tab while the outfit is equipped.

REQUIREMENTS

• SMAPI 4.5.2 or newer
• Fashion Sense 7.5.0 or newer

INSTALLATION

1. Install SMAPI and Fashion Sense.
2. Extract both folders from the mod ZIP into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
3. Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.
4. Open the Fashion Sense Hand Mirror, go to Outfits, and equip the Trafalgar Law preset.

CREDITS

Trafalgar Law is a character from One Piece by Eiichiro Oda. Fashion Sense is by PeacefulEnd.
